title: Musa, Part 6: The Magicians

lines.text: Their ropes and staffs seemed to move, and Musa felt fear inside.
lines.spoken: Their ropes and staffs seemed to move, and Musa felt fear inside.

lines.text: On the festival day, Pharaoh's magicians came to face Musa.
lines.spoken: On the festival day, Pharaoh's magicians came to face Musa.

lines.text: They asked for a reward, and Pharaoh promised: "You will be close to me."
lines.spoken: They asked for a reward, and Pharaoh promised: "You will be close to me."

lines.text: Musa said: "You throw first." Their magic bewitched the people's eyes.
lines.spoken: Musa said: "You throw first." Their magic bewitched the people's eyes.

lines.text: Allah said: "Do not fear, you will be superior. Throw what is in your right hand."
lines.spoken: Allah said: "Do not fear, you will be superior. Throw what is in your right hand."

lines.text: Musa threw his staff, and it swallowed everything they had faked.
lines.spoken: Musa threw his staff, and it swallowed everything they had faked.

lines.text: The truth stood clear, and the magicians fell down in prostration.
lines.spoken: The truth stood clear, and the magicians fell down in prostration.

lines.text: "We believe in the Lord of the worlds, the Lord of Musa and Harun."
lines.spoken: "We believe in the Lord of the worlds, the Lord of Musa and Haaroon."

lines.text: Pharaoh raged: "You believed before I gave permission!" He threatened a terrible punishment.
lines.spoken: Pharaoh raged: "You believed before I gave permission!" He threatened a terrible punishment.

lines.text: They said: "Decree what you will. You can only decree for this worldly life."
lines.spoken: They said: "Decree what you will. You can only decree for this worldly life."

lines.text: "Our Lord, pour upon us patience, and let us die as Muslims."
lines.spoken: "Our Lord, pour upon us patience, and let us die as Muslims."

lines.text: Would Pharaoh ever believe? Follow for Part 7.
lines.spoken: Would Pharaoh ever believe? Follow for Part seven.

fact_notes: Quran 20:57-73 and 7:113-126 (Sahih International via legacy.quran.com, checked 2026-11-22)
The Qur'an gives no number of magicians, so none is stated; the last line is a question only.
